subject.title: [F6] Zero-duration spans indicate missing duration instrumentation

question: Should trajectory JSONL rows gain an explicit measured duration/start-end contract, and which reported row types should become lifecycle spans versus remain point events?
rationale: The current public shape is an event timeline with one timestamp, so adding durations changes exported diagnostic schema semantics and synthetic nonzero durations for point events could make telemetry misleading.

options.title: Add a trajectory timing contract
options.body: Approve additive `durationMs` or start/end fields for operations with real lifecycle timing, with docs and tests for the supported event families.

options.title: Keep trajectory event-only
options.body: Leave trajectory JSONL as point events, clarify the docs, and let the separate OTel latency work own measured spans and metrics.

options.title: Split by event family
options.body: Handle runtime lifecycle rows such as context and prompt timing separately from transcript-derived tool call/result reconstruction.

recommendation.title: Add a trajectory timing contract
recommendation.body: Approve additive `durationMs` or start/end fields for operations with real lifecycle timing, with docs and tests for the supported event families.

likelyOwner.reason: The current checkout and release provenance point to vincentkoc for the trajectory and diagnostics exporter surfaces that need the schema decision.
